sentences.text: Ms. Archana Maheshwari - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Mukesh Parwal appearing on behalf of Advocate Gene  ORDER

By this petition preferred under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner has raised a grievance to the effect that though an award has already been passed for compulsory acquisition of his land determining the compensation to be awarded to him no amount has been paid as yet.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that way back on 05.11.2019 vide Annexure P/1,
the Collector, District Indore had written to the Principal Secretary of Finance Department for doing the needful in the matter and for transferring the amount since the earlier amount which had been transferred had lapsed and had been returned to the department.
It is submitted that though a period of more than five years has elapsed since the same the matter has remained pending and no amount has been paid to the petitioner.

3. Learned counsel for the respondent/State has submitted that since NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:6651 2 WP-4712-2025 there is already a communication by the Collector to the Principal Secretary of Finance Department, no further orders are required as the Principal Secretory no doubt would act upon the communication dated 05.11.2019.
4.

In the available facts of the case, it is directed that respondent No.1, Principal Secretary/Secretary, Finance Department shall forthwith advert to the communication dated 05.11.2019 of the Collector, District Indore and shall trasfer the requisite amount in the account of Lalit vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58131366/
1 the Land Acquisition Officer for the purpose of making payment to the land owners including the petitioner.

sentences.text: In case of any legal impediment in doing so a reasoned and a speaking order be passed within the aforesaid period.

5. Let the same be done within a period of two months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order along with copy of this petition.
6.
With the aforesaid direction, the petition stands disposed off.
